info.title: Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata
info.synopsis: Tomoya Aki è un ragazzo appassionato di anime e manga impegnato anche nella amatoriale produzione di giochi "doujinshi". Tornando a casa una sera incontra una ragazza molto carina e decide di ispirarsi a lei per l'eroina del suo prossimo gioco. Un mese più tardi Tomoya realizza che la ragazza, Megumi, è una sua compagna di classe, un tipo che apparentemente passa sempre inosservata. Nel fiume di eventi che seguono la scoperta, Tomoya cosciente dei suoi limiti artistici, decide di chiedere aiuto all'elemento di punta del club d'arte, la sua amica d'infanzia Eriri Spencer Sawamura, e al "freddo secchione" Utaha Kasumigaoka di aiutarlo a fare i disegni e a scrivere la sceneggiatura per il gioco. Riuscirà  questa "compagnia" a realizzare un buon prodotto e a presentarlo con successo al Comiket?

episodes.title: Un Prologo Pieno di Errori
episodes.synopsis: A chance encounter with a beautiful girl during spring break inspires Tomoya to make a dating simulation video game. He tries recruiting Eriri and Utaha to assist him.

tmdb.title: Un Prologo Pieno di Errori
tmdb.synopsis: A chance encounter with a beautiful girl during spring break inspires Tomoya to make a dating simulation video game. He tries recruiting Eriri and Utaha to assist him.

episodes.title: A Girlfriend Without a Raised Flag
episodes.synopsis: Tomoya asks Megumi out and gives her a lecture on how a perfect heroine should be like. He invites her to his home for an even more detailed lesson!

episodes.title: Retake the Climax
episodes.synopsis: Tomoya continues to procrastinate despite a fast approaching deadline for his project proposal. Eriri and Utaha wonder if he's really serious about creating a dating sim.

episodes.title: Budget, Deadline and New Development
episodes.synopsis: Tomoya sets up a meeting with his recruits to discuss the game. After seeing Megumi with a boy, he can't help but feel jealous!

episodes.title: The Date Event of Crossing Paths
episodes.synopsis: Utaha manages to write out the plot of their game, but it might not be what Tomoya is looking for. Megumi and Tomoya go on a date.

episodes.title: Deciding the Night for Two
episodes.synopsis: Tomoya leaves Kato in the middle of their date to meet up with Utaha. She takes him to a hotel, and they spend the night together. Alone…

episodes.title: Friend, Foe or a New Character
episodes.synopsis: While Tomoya is preparing for the Summer Comiket, two familiar faces from his past show up. Will this affect his game and all the preparations?

episodes.title: A Wingman`s Traumatic Recollection Mode
episodes.synopsis: Megumi makes a concerted effort to understand dating sims. Later, Megumi and Tomoya assist Izumi during Summer Comiket.

episodes.title: One-on-one Route After 8 Years
episodes.synopsis: After Tomoya hurts Eriri's feelings by praising Izumi's book, Utaha and Megumi urge him to make up with her in order to keep their group together.

episodes.title: A Melody of Reminiscing and Support
episodes.synopsis: After an argument with her dad, Michiru runs away and decides to crash at Tomoya's place for a while. In the circle meeting, it is decided that background music is needed for the game. Will they find someone to help them out?

episodes.title: Ready to Start Resolving the Subplots
episodes.synopsis: Tomoya continues his attempts to recruit Michiru to his cause. Her critical words, however, cause Tomoya to question the dedication of his circle's members.

episodes.title: The Ups and Downs at the End of Each Day
episodes.synopsis: The group goes to see Icy Tail's first-ever concert. Before performing, Michiru's bandmates reveal a startling secret.
